overhead-dialogue-when-fighting-in-the-m.text: Throughout this fight, the dialogue follows a set of phrases in the order shown below.
First phrase spoken by the Mysterious Figure:

steps.text: If the Mysterious Figure has above 120 hitpoints:

steps.npc: Come on! Show me a challenge!

steps.text: If the Mysterious Figure has 120 or fewer hitpoints:

steps.npc: That's more like it!

overhead-dialogue-when-fighting-in-the-m.text: Second phrase spoken by the Mysterious Figure:

steps.text: If the Mysterious Figure has above 120 hitpoints:

steps.npc: You can do better than that!

steps.text: If the Mysterious Figure has 120 or fewer hitpoints:

steps.npc: Now we're getting somewhere!

overhead-dialogue-when-fighting-in-the-m.text: Third phrase spoken by the Mysterious Figure:

steps.text: If the Mysterious Figure has above 120 hitpoints:

steps.npc: Is that all you have to give?!

steps.text: If the Mysterious Figure has 120 or fewer hitpoints:

steps.npc: Better! Much better!

overhead-dialogue-when-fighting-in-the-m.text: Fourth phrase spoken by the Mysterious Figure:

steps.text: If the Mysterious Figure has above 120 hitpoints:

steps.npc: I don't know how you lasted this long!

steps.text: If the Mysterious Figure has 120 or fewer hitpoints:

steps.npc: Yes! Show me what you've got!

overhead-dialogue-when-fighting-in-the-m.text: Fifth phrase spoken by the Mysterious Figure:

steps.text: If the Mysterious Figure has above 120 hitpoints:

steps.npc: Some fighter you are!

steps.text: If the Mysterious Figure has 120 or fewer hitpoints:

steps.npc: Finally, a proper challenger!

overhead-dialogue-when-fighting-in-the-m.text: Sixth phrase spoken by the Mysterious Figure:

steps.text: If the Mysterious Figure has above 120 hitpoints:

steps.npc: Really? Is that it?

steps.text: If the Mysterious Figure has 120 or fewer hitpoints:

steps.npc: Good! Now keep it up!
